players.name: Bryan Rust
players.note: Rust (lower body) is skating in a non-contact sweater Friday, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.

players.name: Connor Bedard
players.note: Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months, the Blackhawks announced.

players.name: Ivan Demidov
players.note: Demidov is expected to travel to Vegas and join the Canadiens for practice Friday, Eric Engels of Sportsnet reports.

players.name: Kirill Marchenko
players.note: Marchenko (lower body) is expected back in the lineup against the Bruins on Friday after telling reporters, "My leg feels perfect and I'm ready to go," Mark Masters of TSN reports.

players.name: Pavel Dorofeyev
players.note: Dorofeyev (lower body) will join the Rangers for their two-game road trip, Mollie Walker of the New York Post reports Tuesday.

players.name: Quinn Hughes
players.note: Hughes (upper body) is doubtful to play Friday versus the Avalanche but is expected to join the wild on their road trip, which begins Sunday in Chicago, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Nathan MacKinnon
players.note: MacKinnon (lower body) has been evaluated by a specialist and is expected to miss the next 12 weeks, Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now reports Saturday.
